subject: vision model accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME], 

      We worked with Sewer AI on real-time defect classification across cameras/sensors in variable environments - the friction they hit was perception data underneath the robotics. 

      They used Encord to streamline annotation and QA and keep pace with edge cases coming off production systems. Given 
      AMP's scale, I assume the model feedback loop is relevant to you as well. 

      In case Encord is new to you, we're a data development platform (Series C, $110M) helping robotics perception teams at Boston Dynamics, Agility, and Dyna Robotics improve training data quality and post-deployment results. 

      Would love to be connected and share learnings. Open to a quick chat next week?

subject: ML infra for vision models
text:
Hi [NAME], 

      We worked with Sewer AI on real-time defect classification across cameras and sensors in variable lighting and environments - key challenge they faced was on the infra side: annotation pipeline, QA workflow, and eval struggled to keep pace with huge data volumes. 

      At 
      AMP's scale, I can imagine that the gap between model interaction and data infra could widen fast. 

      Quick intro - Encord (Series C, $110M raised) is a data development platform for physical AI teams to streamline ML ops - we helped teams like Boston Dynamics, Pi, Dyna, Woven scale their training data pipeline across billions of objects / frames. 

      Would love to hear how you're approaching this and share learnings. Open to a quick chat next week?

subject: model feedback loop
text:
Hi [NAME],

When AMP's vision model hits a new material or edge case in the field, how
fast does that get back into training?

We recently worked w/ Sewer AI on exactly that gap - Encord helps
perception teams close the loop between production edge cases and model
improvement - teams like Boston Dynamics, Dyna Robotics, and Woven/Toyota
rely on our tooling to speed up annotation and model eval.

Happy to connect and share what we've seen work at similar scale. Open to a
quick 20min later this week?
